title: BEYOND HIDDEN-LAYER MANIPULATION: SEMANTICALLY-AWARE LOGIT INTERVENTIONS FOR DEBIASING LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Winogender dataset (pronoun resolution tasks) and StereoSet, converted into a controlled multiple-choice A/B/C format to measure the selection rates of stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical completions.
Measured primarily using the StereoSet benchmark, formatted as multiple-choice questions with removable biasing contexts to calculate stereotype and anti-stereotype selection scores.
Evaluated using the StereoSet benchmark, adapted into a standardized A/B/C multiple-choice structure to assess model preference for stereotypical professional associations.

Assessed using comprehensive broad-coverage bias benchmarks (BBQ and CrowS-Pairs), transformed from their original formats (e.g., ambiguous questions and minimal pairs) into a unified multiple-choice framework to measure context-induced stereotyping.
